name: Hari Kampo
description: Hari Kampo — A kampo pharmacy theme set as an asymmetric masonry in hiwa siskin yellow-green (#D7CF3A), the main colour on the header, the stacked-collage hero, the consultation band and every page head, over a pencil-sketched herb pattern texture, with graphite green ink and herb paper; RocknRoll One display over IBM Plex Sans JP. The art is pencil-sketch raster illustration (graphite cross-hatching with a hiwa wash): three sketches of the herbs, the drawer wall and the decoction pot stacked as a collage, a ginseng root as a transparent cut-out that breaks over the collage, the section edge and a card, and a seamless herb pattern used as texture on the hiwa fields and masonry tiles. A full top header with the pharmacy name centred, the menu centred beneath it between ink rules, and a Book a consultation button. Vertical Japanese only on Japanese text; English always runs horizontally. The consultation fees and the pharmacy details are synced patterns edited in one place. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b3-16 (asymmetric-masonry, stacked-collage hero, centered nav, pattern-texture images, pencil-sketch illustration, hiwa #D7CF3A, RocknRoll One + IBM Plex Sans JP); plus one cut-out break-frame ginseng. Contrast: graphite ink #1F2410 on hiwa #D7CF3A 9.8:1 (all text on the hiwa header, hero, consultation band, tiles and page heads); white on graphite 15.9:1; hiwa on graphite 9.8:1 (footer name); graphite on herb paper #F7F5DF 14.5:1; olive #5E5A0C on paper 6.5:1 and on white 7.1:1; white on olive 7.1:1; quiet #4E4F36 on paper 7.7:1; white never on hiwa (1.6:1).

fonts.role: display: headings, the pharmacy name, vertical Japanese labels, herb names and prices

summary.zh-TW: 鉛筆素描風的漢方藥局網站：鶸色主視覺疊放三張素描拼貼，去背的人參破框而出，下方是不對稱瀑布流的生藥抽屜與諮詢費用。
summary.en: A pencil-sketch kampo pharmacy site: a hiwa stacked-collage hero, a cut-out ginseng breaking its frame, a herb masonry and fees.
summary.ja: 鉛筆スケッチ風の漢方薬局サイト。鶸色のコラージュヒーローから切り抜きの人参が枠を越え、生薬のメーソンリーと相談料が続きます。
summary.fr: Une pharmacie kampo au crayon : héros en collage sur fond hiwa, ginseng détouré qui déborde, mosaïque de plantes et tarifs.
summary.de: Eine Kampo-Apotheke als Bleistiftskizze: Collage-Hero in Hiwa, freigestellter Ginseng ragt heraus, Kräuter-Mosaik und Preise.
